amanda: Quick sync — planning to enable per-customer allowlist for tenant acme-inc tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need eng-platform signoff on canary audience, VIP handling, and rollback thresholds.

raj: Sounds good. Canary size?

amanda: Thinking 1% initially. Exclude VIP accounts and contract-gated ones unless explicitly opted in.

leo: For contract gating, are we checking contract flag `feature_x_opt_in` or doing explicit allowlist? Prefer contract check + allowlist for VIPs.

sophie: Agreed. Suggest rule: if contract.feature_x_opt_in == true AND tenant in allowlist then enable. VIPs (tags: vip) should be excluded from canary for first 24h.

mike: I'll watch SLOs. If error-rate > 0.5% OR 95p latency increases > 30% vs baseline, trigger rollback. I can also alert on model-fallback counts.

amanda: Thanks. PR #4321 adds allowlist AND contract gating. @raj can you review? @leo can you confirm the fallback path uses model-variant-b?

raj: I'll review by EOD. If quick, can merge + schedule toggle.

leo: Confirmed fallback -> model-variant-b with reduced batch-size. That path has been smoke-tested on staging.

feature-bot: feature-flag-service scheduled toggle: enterprise_per_customer.acme-inc -> ENABLE at 1851283200 (09:00 PT).

sophie: Ops note — add annotation in rollout doc with the contract clause and VIP exclusion list.

amanda: I'll post the rollout checklist and dashboard link shortly. Thanks all :thumbsup:

feature-bot: feature-flag-service: toggle executed successfully for enterprise_per_customer.acme-inc at 1851283200. :rotating_light:
